title: Episodic Consolidation Contract (Stage 4)
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool consolidate`, dispatched to the Node 1 Episodic Memory Consolidation endpoint (POST /api/v1/memory/consolidate, :8084). The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

ConsolidationReceipt.description: Statistical summary of graph mutations committed during consolidation.

trace_id.description: Correlation trace identifier for the episode.

episode_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the committed episode.

nodes_updated.description: Count of knowledge graph nodes updated or reinforced.

entities_extracted.description: Count of new entities extracted from the deliberation trace.

nodes_fused.description: Count of duplicate nodes fused via entity resolution.

decay_applied.description: Whether Hebbian background decay was triggered.

latency_ms.description: Node 1 consolidation execution latency in milliseconds.

request.description: Payload dispatched to Node 1. Populated from CLI flags --goal, --outcome, --session-id, and --sync.

goal.description: The objective or mission deliberated during the session (CLI flag --goal).

outcome.description: The final outcome status of the deliberation trajectory (CLI flag --outcome).

trace.description: Optional full deliberation trajectory payload serialised as JSON (CLI flag --trace).

sync.description: When true, blocks until graph consolidation and decay complete synchronously (CLI flag --sync).
